description: Notices devices arriving on the machine's USB and serial buses and files each arrival as an Oracle signal.
name: usb_arrivals

signals.description: A device id not seen before arrived on a watched bus (USB or serial).
signals.name: device_arrived

signals.description: A new USB mass-storage device (device class 08) arrived; the stronger statement, filed instead of device_arrived.
signals.name: storage_arrived
